title: LTC7001 共源隔离MOS在12V_DRV掉电时的关断闭合候选
scope: 只处理LTC7001驱动Q_ISO1/Q_ISO2时，12V_DRV掉电及BUS/超容单路掉电的关断供电。无PCB、固件或实测工作。

decision.summary: 保留LTC7001和共源双HYG022隔离MOS；用BUS_EXT与SC_ISO_STORAGE经双路二极管OR供给100V LDO，产生独立ISO_VCC。只要两路原始能源至少一路仍满足输入门槛，LTC7001就不会因12V_DRV单独掉电而失去TGDN供电状态；同时要求既有外部锁存器在12V_DRV掉电时异步清零并把INP拉低。

count_neutral_changes: TGUP串阻采用退役组的R_QP_COL=HoAR0603-1/10W-10KR-0.1%-TCR25（LCSC C5123581）；不新增R_ISO_TGUP/100R。R_QP_COL按旧BOM已有实物引用复用，不重复计数。
component_delta_local.scope_note: 这是本隔离关断子块相对原隔离候选的局部差额，不是稳压板总新增数量或合并BOM。

decision.why: LTC7001数据手册规定VCCUV开路时VCC欠压期间TGDN拉到TS，但没有保证VCC=0时TGDN输出仍为低阻。单独OR供电让单路能源消失时IC仍处于有供电的工作条件；不把10M栅源电阻当作掉电快速关断证明。

parts.package: SOT-23 dual common-cathode silicon low-leakage switching diode
parts.procurement: 精确MPN已定；供应商料号、库存和价格未核。

parts.package: DGN-8 with exposed PowerPAD, library pad 9
parts.accuracy_boundary: 在VIN>24V时，器件仍处于7..100V推荐输入范围，但TI的±2.5%全温总精度条件不覆盖该输入；不得外推此误差界。过压/夹位下仍有100V额定余量，但VCC精度下界须由制造商保证数据或重新选型闭合。

parts.requirement: 全工作电压和温度下有效电容必须不少于TI要求的1uF；100V额定值覆盖69.4V夹位筛查值，但X7S的DC-bias降容需以厂家适用曲线或最小规格核实。
全工作电压和温度下有效电容必须大于4.7uF以满足TPS7A4001稳定性要求。X7S及容量容差已知，但公开DC-bias曲线为典型值；所需有效容量不是现有资料中的全温保证值。

C_ISO_VCC.new_connection: LTC7001 pin1 VCC/ISO_VCC to GND_SYS; local bypass

connections.pin4_INP: 既有硬件许可/FF输出；12V_DRV掉电必须使其为低

C_ISO_BST.connection: LTC7001 BST pin9 to TS pin8

R_ISO_GATE_SOURCE.reason: 10MΩ在已知两只MOS合计200nA漏电时形成2V压降，等于HYG022最小VGS(th)，没有关断余量；2.2MΩ时为0.44V。2.2MΩ的供应商料号/报价尚未核实。

D_ISO_BST_START.reason: 现有VCC到BST二极管在TS已高于VCC时不能为BST-TS提供预充；不依赖它作快速启动。采用硬件许可新ARM，不规定未有数据手册保证的启动最大时间。

source_operating_window.design_limit: LDO pin8及EN pin5瞬态必须保持<=100V；OR二极管承受的BUS与SC输入差压必须<=180V。69.4V是SMCJ43A在其规定浪涌电流下的最大夹位规格筛查值，不能覆盖未建模线束过冲。

LDO_output_bounds.validity: These output bounds are guaranteed only when the TPS7A4001 input accuracy condition VIN<=24V is met and capacitors/load meet the datasheet requirements. For normal BUS>24V they are not guaranteed bounds.

current_budget.pump_boundary: 15uA minimum is specified at the single stated TS=20V/BST-TS=10V point; do not extend this guaranteed current to TS=21.6V. 225uA total LTC supply current is typical only. Maximum VCC supply current is 50uA under its listed VCC table condition.

maximum_rail_load_screen.qualification: LDO power estimate uses maximum listed IGND/IEN, full output-current screen and stated package RθJA; CIN leakage is an insulation-resistance screen, not a hot-temperature leakage guarantee.

output_reservoir_screen.calculation: 22uF × 0.8 tolerance × 0.78 X7S temperature factor × 0.5 assumed DC-bias retention
output_reservoir_screen.qualification: 50% DC-bias retention是筛查假设，不是TDK全温保证值。理想放电时间假设LDO不反灌且负载恒定；TPS7A4001输入掉电时输出端的反向放电未纳入保证，因此这不是BUS与SC同时失电时的保持时间承诺。已覆盖的是任一原始电源仍高于门槛时由OR连续供电。

turn_off_timing.test_condition: LTC7001 datasheet: VINP falling, CL=1nF, fast input edge; only driver IC condition, not system current-interruption time.
turn_off_timing.pull_down_resistance_condition: VCC=VBST=12V; this is a powered driver test condition.
turn_off_timing.guarantee_limit: HYG022 Qg/Qgd are typical, no maximum total gate charge is stated. Therefore no guaranteed complete gate discharge time or inductor-current interruption time can be calculated from these values. The 70ns propagation maximum does not include comparator/FF delay, gate discharge or clamp current decay.

fault_matrix.result: ISO_VCC is sourced through the BUS_EXT diode. With VIN<=24V the output lower bound is 11.345V (>6.9V falling UVLO). If BUS exceeds24V, LDO precision guarantee is not covered; raw VIN remains within recommended range only if <=100V.
fault_matrix.required_logic: 12V_DRV loss must asynchronously clear U_ISO_ARM_FF and force U_SC_ISO_GATE.INP low; the auxiliary supply does not sense or latch 12V_DRV loss.

fault_matrix.result: The SC-side OR diode powers the LDO directly from the storage side upstream of Q_ISO1/Q_ISO2; VIN>=19.28V by the 0.72V-at-1mA VF screen, giving sufficient LDO headroom and VIN<=24V accuracy coverage.
fault_matrix.required_logic: On 12V_DRV loss the external fresh-arm latch must clear and LTC INP must be low.

fault_matrix.result: BUS branch powers LTC VCC; SC-side loss alone does not force LTC VCC to zero.

fault_matrix.condition: BUS_EXT=0 and SC_ISO_STORAGE below 15V or both sources absent
fault_matrix.result: No guaranteed regulated ISO_VCC; LTC7001 TGDN at VCC=0 is unspecified. RGS only provides passive leakage bleed and no guaranteed fast-off or maximum time.

fault_matrix.condition: D_ISO_AUX_OR open/short, LDO output short, or ISO_VCC short to ground
fault_matrix.result: Not covered. A shorted OR leg can cross-couple BUS and SC. The single-source matrix assumes the OR network and LDO are intact.

integration_dependencies_and_limits: 硬件许可链必须保证12V_DRV跌落触发FF异步清零；只有LTC供电连续而INP仍高会让开关继续导通。故障解除后必须重新产生PB5_ARM新边沿，禁止电源恢复自动重开。
本方案消除12V_DRV单独失电导致LTC VCC=0的状态，不宣称BUS与SC同时失电、器件供电脚短路、OR/LDO失效时的TGDN=低保证。
R_ISO_GATE_SOURCE=2.2M仅按两只HYG022各100nA最大门极漏电和C_ISO_BST绝缘电阻预算，静态VGS约0.44V；若用2uA未知漏电预算则会得到4.4V，不能声称无电源时仍低于HYG022最小阈值2V。
LTC7001 BST-TS启动泵电流/启动时间没有覆盖整个0..21.6V TS输入范围的最大启动时间保证。内部BST-TS欠压保护典型值约3.1V；新ARM时序不能承诺固定1s上限。
避免向IRLB4030施加14V自举；本节点仅驱HYG022，LTC7001 BST-TS最大列值筛查14V，低于HYG022±20V VGS绝对额定值，但不得误接到IRLB4030门极。
按当前母线TVS筛查，SMCJ43A最大夹位69.4V低于TPS7A4001推荐输入100V，余量30.6V；须把原始输入脚线束过冲限制在100V以内，105V为绝对最大值，不作为连续工作点。
未冻结的12V失效检测阈值、FF复位极性/逻辑门、LDO电容DC-bias保证与LTC泵在TS=21.6V的最小电流仍需在主原理设计中闭合。

LT8228_component_count_comparison.official_function_fit: LT8228 Rev C的V2保护驱动DG2/DS2支持共源背靠背M4A/M4B，disable或故障时内部将DG2短接到DS2；从功能上可替代LTC7001及其BST-TS电荷泵驱动。
potential_local_deletions: LTC7001及其独立VCC供电子块（本附件新增6件）
TGUP开通串阻可改由DG2限流配置承担
must_remain_or_be_added: 系统掉电后不自动恢复的fresh-arm锁存仍需外部实现；LT8228自身过流/冷却周期会自动重试。
DG2限涌流应用仍需RDG2、CDG2配置，至少两只无源件，且其MOS电容/斜率须重新计算。
若把LT8228作为完整双向变换器主控替换现有DRV8161方案，需另计两方向电流感测、限流设定、两路补偿、开关频率/软启动/供电外围及其器件数量。
LT8228_component_count_comparison.count_conclusion: 在隔离驱动局部，LT8228确有减少LTC供电与BST外围的潜力，不能只因主芯片单价排除；但其为完整双向变换控制器，不是只换门极驱动的drop-in。未形成完整LT8228候选原理图/BOM前，无法严谨比较全板总器件数或断言总数减少。
